entry.title: [WATCH] linux - security update
entry.summary: [WATCH] Several vulnerabilities have been discovered in the Linux kernel that may lead to a privilege escalation, denial of service or information leaks. https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6652-1 Debian stable. Run apt update and apt upgrade, then reboot if the kernel changed. Source: https://lists.debian.org/debian-security-announce/2026/msg00574.html
